evals.prompt: 请把这张沙丘照片做成一张安静的照片借形海报，轮廓由你判断。
evals.expected_output: Classify the source as mass-led, identify a dune ridge as the keystone, compare low-anatomy resting forms, and use a contained role map with a small completion budget.
expectations: Uses the uploaded photo as the sole visual-content source
Classifies the source by carrier logic before choosing a target
Identifies a keystone dune mass and maps at least three source regions
Avoids eyes, paws, fur drawing, or other detailed anatomy

evals.prompt: 把森林瀑布转成一个像水母的形态，但还要看得出这是森林里的瀑布。
evals.expected_output: Use a flow-led permeable architecture in which waterfall curtains carry the target and forest material crosses selected boundaries without creating an underwater scene.
expectations: Uses the waterfall as the keystone flow
Selects the permeable architecture
Preserves continuous forest and waterfall identity
Creates at least two source-derived boundary crossings

evals.prompt: 这张航拍林路适不适合做成叶片？适合的话直接做，不适合就换轮廓。
evals.expected_output: Test whether the real road can act as the leaf midrib and stem. Use a contained leaf only when the topology supplies the primary structure without invented vein diagrams.
expectations: Classifies the source as topology-led
Tests the user's target instead of accepting it automatically
Maps the road to midrib and stem and canopy to blade masses
Does not invent a symmetrical botanical vein system

evals.prompt: 用雪山和森林做一个向上展开的单翼，不要画羽毛。
evals.expected_output: Use a hybrid gestural architecture: mountain peak as hinge, rising ridge as sweep, and forest bands as a restrained flight-feather rhythm.
expectations: Identifies a source-derived hinge and dominant upward motion
Uses gestural architecture
Keeps source motion dominant over feather anatomy
Rejects a full bird or standalone feather

evals.prompt: 这张海浪能不能变成一匹奔马？
evals.expected_output: Evaluate anatomy complexity and completion cost before proceeding. Prefer a less anatomical or more archetypal moving form when multiple finished limbs and facial structures would be required.
expectations: Penalizes several independently completed limbs and facial parts
Does not assume motion match alone is sufficient
If proceeding, keeps the wave motion dominant and distal anatomy incomplete
Offers a lower-completion alternative when the requested target is forced

evals.prompt: 现在轮廓不错，但让主体再和周围环境融合一些。
evals.expected_output: Inspect the chosen architecture first. Add boundary crossings for permeable work, small texture escapes for contained work, or stronger motion continuity for gestural work instead of applying one universal fusion recipe.
expectations: Treats the supplied draft as the edit target
Diagnoses architecture before revising
Changes only the dominant continuity failure
Does not simulate fusion by uniformly lowering opacity

evals.prompt: 这张照片看不出适合什么动物，你自由发挥做成视觉转译作品。
evals.expected_output: Broaden candidates beyond animals, classify the source, find a keystone, and select a low-completion biological, botanical, geological, atmospheric, object-like, or unnamed form.
expectations: Does not force an animal target
Generates and scores multiple candidates
Chooses an architecture based on the source
Selects a form that feels reasonable without explanation
